purpose.title: 1. Purpose of the service
purpose.text: NeuroZen offers tools to manage work stress and connects workers with licensed psychologists. It does not replace emergency care: in a crisis, call the local emergency line or go to the nearest emergency service.

data.title: 2. Data we process
data.text: We process your account data (name, email) and the information you record on the platform, in accordance with Peru's Personal Data Protection Law No. 29733 and its regulations.

health.title: 3. Sensitive health data
health.text: Your stress records and mental health information are sensitive data. They are used only to provide the service, are never sold, and are only seen by a professional when you book a session with them.

professionals.title: 4. Verified professionals
professionals.text: Psychologists can only see clients on NeuroZen after our team verifies their license number and status with the Peruvian College of Psychologists.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.text: You can access, rectify, cancel or object to the processing of your data by writing to info{'@'}neurozen.com.

zenbot.subtitle: NeuroZen assistant
zenbot.disclaimer: ZenBot gives automatic answers and doesn't replace a professional. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

quick.specialist: I want to talk to a psychologist

answers.welcome: Hi! I'm ZenBot 🌿 I'm here to guide you with work stress. Tell me how you feel or pick an option.
answers.crisis: I'm really sorry you're going through this. You're not alone and your life matters. Please reach out for help right now: call a crisis line or, if you're in immediate danger, your local emergency number. You can also talk to a NeuroZen specialist today.
answers.sad: I'm sorry you feel this way; your feelings are valid. Talking to a professional can really help. Meanwhile, a breathing exercise can give you a moment of calm.
answers.anxiety: I understand, stress can be exhausting. Two suggestions: a few minutes of guided breathing, and logging what caused it so you can spot your patterns.
answers.sleep: Poor sleep increases stress. Try disconnecting from screens before bed and practice 4-7-8 breathing, which helps you relax. The library has resources about rest.
answers.work: Workload is one of the most common causes of stress. Scheduling active breaks during your day and logging difficult situations will help you manage it.
answers.breathing: Great idea! Guided breathing reduces tension in minutes. We have three exercises: mindful, box and 4-7-8.
answers.breaks: Active breaks are short pauses to move and stretch during your workday. You can set how often to take them.
answers.trigger: Logging what stresses you (when, what happened, how intense) helps you find patterns. Your logs feed your statistics.
answers.test: The self-assessment has 10 questions about the last month and gives you guidance on your stress level.
answers.resources: In the library you'll find audio, videos, readings and exercises for your wellbeing.
answers.appointments: In “My appointments” you can see your sessions, cancel them, share a report with your psychologist and rate completed sessions.
answers.specialist: Talking to a professional is a great decision. All our psychologists have verified licenses. You can book a session in a few steps.
answers.subscription: We have Basic, Advanced and Professional plans. You can see what each includes in the subscriptions section.
answers.thanks: You're welcome! I'll be here when you need me. 🌿
answers.bye: See you soon! Remember to take a moment for yourself today.
answers.help: I can guide you about stress, anxiety, sleep or workload, and take you to NeuroZen's tools: breathing, active breaks, stress log, resources or a specialist.
answers.greeting: Hi! How are you feeling today? You can tell me what's on your mind.
answers.fallback: I'm not sure I understood. Try other words or pick an option below.
answers.fallbackSpecialist: It seems your situation needs more personal attention than I can give. I recommend talking to one of our specialists.
